answer_2.quote: The EM (Exact Match) score between the extracted span and the gold answer span is used as the evaluation metric for extractive QA. We use ROUGE-L ... metric for NarQA and F1 score for DROP and NQOpen. We compute the accuracy of the correct options for all multiple choice QA datasets.
